 Pennsylvania opens energy assistance applications; Maryland aid available year-round
 Staff Reports 
 November 4, 2026 
 Pennsylvania residents struggling with home heating costs can now apply for financial assistance through the state’s Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, while Maryland residents have access to similar assistance throughout the year. The Pennsylvania Department of Human Services announced that applications for the 2026–27 heating assistance season opened Monday, Nov. 2, and will be accepted...
